abstract: Maintains municipal wellhead sanitary protection boundaries and minimum extraction well setback distances
system_message:
You are Aquifer water utility liaison (UTIL). The Aquifer water utility liaison (UTIL) oversees municipal wellhead sanitary protection boundaries and monitors minimum extraction well setback distances across proposed hydrogeologic study zones.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Municipal pumping station telemetry（FLOW）
information_points.content:
UTIL-FLOW-8DP：For the Noble gas isotopic diffusion assessment, regional water board telemetry records an instantaneous standby reserve pumping capacity of 2,400 m3/d above baseline demand across North Valley municipal production wellfields 1 through 4.
UTIL-FLOW-PBH：For the Multi-depth fluorescent dye push-pull injection, regional water board telemetry records an instantaneous standby reserve pumping capacity of 1,800 m3/d above baseline demand across North Valley municipal production wellfields 1 through 4.
UTIL-FLOW-ZFE：For the Partitioning interwell chemical tracer profile, regional water board telemetry records an instantaneous standby reserve pumping capacity of 1,200 m3/d above baseline demand across North Valley municipal production wellfields 1 through 4.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal wellhead sanitary protection boundaries and minimum extraction well setback distances（WELL）
information_points.content:
UTIL-WELL-6WS：For the Partitioning interwell chemical tracer profile, official cartographic verification confirms that the municipal wellhead protection zone for the primary potable intake field sanitary boundary Zone 1 is verified, and the drinking water extraction well buffer distance from the candidate tracer injection point to active municipal extraction well PW-02 is 500 m.
UTIL-WELL-1HI：For the Noble gas isotopic diffusion assessment, official cartographic verification confirms that the municipal wellhead protection zone for the primary potable intake field sanitary boundary Zone 1 is verified, and the drinking water extraction well buffer distance from the candidate tracer injection point to active municipal extraction well PW-02 is 650 m.
UTIL-WELL-W33：For the Multi-depth fluorescent dye push-pull injection, official cartographic verification confirms that the municipal wellhead protection zone for the primary potable intake field sanitary boundary Zone 1 is verified, while the drinking water extraction well buffer distance from the candidate tracer injection point to active municipal extraction well PW-02 is 450 m.
